## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

Given CAUTION and MAJOR divergence, remain selective and monitor megacap trend reversals.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch NVDA (1W: +2.67% | 1M: +0.20%) ABOVE TREND — failure to hold 1W gains risks quick unwind; AAPL (1W: -0.16% | 1M: +2.79%) CORRECTION — needs 1W reversal to reduce downside risk; XOM (1W: -0.91% | 1M: -0.28%) BELOW TREND — continued 1M weakness would confirm deeper energy slide.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION, style mixed / no clear leadership. FCX (1W: +3.43% | 1M: +24.02%) ABOVE TREND, EL (1W: +6.90% | 1M: +25.16%) ABOVE TREND and COF (1W: +1.63% | 1M: +20.53%) ABOVE TREND showing relative strength. Key risk: major divergence among mega-caps (AAPL, GOOGL, JPM) in CORRECTION — watch for trend breaks before adding broad exposure.
